mode.title: Compile on save
mode.description: auto: not in projects whose package.json uses Vite, webpack, Parcel, Next.js, Nuxt or Angular CLI, which build their styles themselves. The commands compile in every mode.

outDir.title: Output directory
outDir.description: Relative to the project root, keeping each file's folders (src/a.scss → <dir>/src/a.css); empty writes next to the source.

ignore.title: Files not to compile
ignore.description: One project-relative glob per line (** crosses folders).
